title: CADKit current artifact, lineage, and open-source peer boundary
mode: deeper/broader primary-source research and plan refinement
scope: Reconcile current published CADKit DWG and DXF subcrate versions
Refresh CADKit native-decoder versus neutral-model evidence boundaries
Recheck ACadSharp algorithm and corpus lineage
Screen wrappers and source-visible candidates for independent implementation and open-source status
Refine optional peer admission without adding recurring validation work

sources.project: TNYCL/cadkit published crates and repository README
sources.observation: The currently surfaced package versions are cadkit-dwg 0.3.0 and cadkit-dxf 0.3.3. The project declares DWG read without DWG write, DXF ASCII/Binary read and ASCII write, and explicitly marks AC1012/R13 untested in its README despite the crate API listing that version magic.

sources.project: TNYCL/cadkit DWG format notes and provenance ledger
sources.observation: The project reports exact consumption for completed object decoders, whole-document comparisons against its own DXF reader for selected AC versions, and structural decoding of Apache Tika samples. Its notes list modeler records as partial/opaque. Its provenance ledger identifies ACadSharp samples and attributes the R2007 LZ77 decompressor and R2007 container flow to ACadSharp. These claims were not independently reproduced.

The native route retains raw object bytes with decoded native data; the facade maps to cadkit_core::Document and documents recoverable warnings/unknown cases. This supports staging a future comparison by decode, projection, and output rather than treating the facade model as lossless input.

acadrust.js consumes ACadRust as an unmodified Cargo dependency and is not a separate codec lineage. obj2cad documents its own SAT/SAB and DXF authoring routes but identifies its DWG writer as patched ACadRust and says DWG remains beta pending AutoCAD acceptance.

The project describes its source as proprietary rather than open source, states its initial implementation scope is DXF-only, and says DWG and a native B-rep kernel are not implemented. It is excluded from the open-source peer set and source reuse.

planImpact.implementationSummary: Corrected the stale CADKit DWG crate version (0.3.0; DXF crate 0.3.3), documented the ACadSharp-shared R2007 path and corpus lineage, and required native decode/projection/output stages to remain separate. Classified ACadRust bindings and obj2cad DWG output under their underlying codec lineage and excluded a proprietary source-visible DXF project. No local defect or implementation item was added.
planImpact.nextImplementation: Continue the existing local-ready implementation queue and fast validation. Use CADKit only at an existing composed checkpoint for a named structural question, with exact package/source provenance and locally authored or already admitted inputs.

method.limitations: The comparison is based on current published API metadata and mutable project documentation without downloading or executing peer packages. It does not independently verify CADKit decoder correctness, native CAD acceptance, 3D semantics, or source provenance embedded in an artifact.
